newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close weaker, Sept breaks support.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close weaker, Sept breaks support.

text.p: FCOJ futures ended a dull session lower as the benchmark September contract slipped under its downside target ahead of the close.
Traders blamed losses on early speculativve selling and a lack of buying interest throughout the day.
"There are no fresh fundamentals and a general lack of interest," an analyst said.

Technically, several indicators point to weaker prices. The analyst said the stochastics are pointed lower and the Bollinger bands show support around 73.60 cents and then at 72.00 cents basis September.

The benchmark contract settled 0.95 cent lower at 73.85 cents per lb, having ranged from 75.10 to 73.75 cents. Second-position November ended down 1.10 cents at 76.35 cents, having hit a new contract low of 76.20 cents during the session. The rest of the board settled 0.80 to 1.80 weaker.
An estimated 1,500 lots changed hands, compared with Wednesday's official 1,353 lots.
